name: Xindong Huiyi
source:
Nobunaga, a teenage boy returning his home town after several years abroad to finish the final year of high school. Upon starting the new school year, he is reunited with his childhood sweetheart Kazami Chinatsu while also encountering four different girls under different circumstances. Who's hand will Nobunaga take? Make in-game decision to decide how the story will play out.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150426000135/http://en.ariesgames.net/games/2015-02-28/17.html]Official Website[/url]]
